value.rationale: A natural symmetry-preserving two-dimensional Ciani family unifies superspeciality of elliptic quotient factors. The complete degeneration divisor is a meaningful geometric invariant, not arbitrary finite sampling: it has five irreducible components, seven transverse superspecial intersections and four exact arithmetic rank strata. The result distinguishes p-rank 1 from p-rank 2 along different components, and specifies all coefficients over the smallest extension containing the crossings. General literature supplies quotient methods but not this explicit arithmetic geometry; it is useful for detailed Ciani/Howe moduli and superspecial searches without claiming isomorphism-class uniqueness.
